verdicts.reason: A keeps the shoe in its lime circle and the logo, badge, headline and subcopy in a sensible top-to-bottom order. But there is a big empty band between the badge and the headline, the subcopy is tiny, and the bottom third below 'Full review inside.' is dead space. B breaks up the key image: the shoe floats on its own while a cropped green circle sits in the bottom-right corner. The 'Full review inside.' subcopy is set almost as large as the headline and competes with it, the centred logo clashes with the left-aligned headline, and the NEW VIDEO badge has drifted to the bottom, cut off from the top of the reading order.
